script_text: Stop, Pisces — the planets are demanding your attention right now. Neptune, your ruler, is completing a sextile to Saturn in your 10th House of Career, signaling a quiet but powerful shift in your professional recognition. The emotional tides of water are clashing with structure, and you will feel this tension in your daily work. In love, Venus is moving into a harmonious trine with Jupiter in your 7th House of Partnerships, drawing a deeply meaningful connection your way if you are single, or awakening tenderness in a current bond. Career money flows through the 10th House — expect an unexpected opportunity or recognition that reshapes your path. A warning: do not abandon your boundaries out of pity today. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
